last_actions: Copied mimae-concept.md from ~/storage/downloads into repo root
Initialized git repo and committed concept doc + agent state
Recorded decisions D1-D13 in DECISIONS.md
Step 1 implemented: src/{lib,ids,actor,entities,event}.rs + tests/vocab.rs; 8 tests pass, clippy -D warnings clean, fmt clean
Step 2 implemented: src/log.rs — append-only JSON-lines log, flock single-writer, fsync per append, torn-tail recovery on open; tests/log.rs 7 tests pass, clippy/fmt clean

Step 3: src/graph.rs (strict fold, stream()-based replay, dep-gated readiness, deterministic ready ordering, atomic claim) + src/team.rs (TeamState lifecycle incl. initializing->ready->running) + tests (graph: 8 incl. 50-task 2-thread barrier concurrency stress & from-log replay equality; team: 4) — 27 tests, clippy/fmt clean, commit c41a22b

Step 3.5: src/coordinator.rs — single ingest point owning EventLog+TaskGraph+TeamRegistry; publish/claim use validate-then-commit (dry-run on cloned views, append, swap) so rejected events never reach the log; D16 recorded (late joiners full members, gate never re-engages). 31 tests pass, clippy/fmt clean, commit 5113dea

Step 4: Lease gains ttl_ms; heartbeat extends expires_at_ms by ttl_ms; Coordinator::check_for_expired_leases sweeps by publishing LeaseExpired (no timer thread — driven at query time). Regression tests for InReview expiry, heartbeat TTL extension, sweep idempotence and from-log replay after sweep. 36 tests, clippy/fmt clean.

Step 5: src/adapter.rs — AgentAdapter trait contract (capabilities, start_session, send_turn, interrupt, resume, inject_context, liveness), SessionEvent normalized event types (Ok/Error/ToolUse/ToolResult/Usage/PermissionRequest/TurnComplete/StateChanged) with serde, TransportMode enum (HeadlessJson/LocalHttpServer/SSE/Pty). AdapterCapabilities carries can_interrupt/resume/inject/hooks + declared_capabilities. AgentState now Copy+Default. tests/adapter.rs with scripted impl + roundtrip. 39 incidents tests pass, clippy/fmt clean.

Step 6: OpenCode T3 adapter — OpenCodeAdapter::spawn_local spawns `opencode serve` on a free port, wait_for_health polls with a 3s timeout, start_session POSTs /session, send_turn POSTs /session/:id/message and maps message parts (text/tool/step-finish) into SessionEvent, interrupt via POST .../abort, resume via GET .../session/:id, inject_context via POST .../message with noReply=true. Health checks, ureq requests have per-call timeouts (3s health / 10s resume+inject / 60s turn / 120s server child start). Live test opencode_live_session_semantics verifies contract against a real opencode server when the binary is on PATH (skipped otherwise); capabilites were exercised: start_session returned Started, send_turn returned Vec<SessionEvent> ending TurnComplete, interrupt true + Idle liveness, inject true. 41 tests total, clippy/fmt clean.

Step 8: src/antigravity.rs — AntigravityAdapter implementing AgentAdapter over `agy -p <prompt> --output-format stream-json`, conversation_id captured from events, resume via --conversation, per-turn child kill on Drop. MimoCode added to CliKind. parse_agy_stream_line exposed for pure-parser test. tests/antigravity.rs contract + offline parser + live gated on binary (skipped: agy not on PATH).

Step 9: gate4agent rechecked at v0.4.8 (MIT; 546 commits, 9 stars, 2 forks; rapid 0.4.x releases on 2026-10-02): first-tier Claude Code/Codex/Kimi/Grok, legacy Gemini/OpenCode, qwen removed; no Antigravity/Qwen/Mimo; async/tokio workbench surface mismatches Mimae's sync deterministic core. D3 closed as learn-from/do-not-depend.

Planner loop: src/planner.rs — plan_goal validates empty goal, duplicate/unknown tasks, dependency cycles, overlapping write scopes among parallel tasks (plan-vs-plan and plan-vs-active), shared-interface contract coverage, then publishes GoalSubmitted/TaskCreated/ContractProposed with causal chaining; propose/accept/change_contract + record_decision; next_assignment/assign by capability match; goal_progress with is_complete. TaskGraph now folds contracts (propose/accept/change with version checks). ContractStatus made Copy. tests/planner.rs: 6 tests (happy path, overlap/cycle/missing-contract rejection with zero log side effects, contract loop + replay equality, capability assignment + goal completion + replay equality). 59 tests total, clippy/fmt clean, commit f54b035.

Phase 4: src/workspace.rs — WorkspaceManager (create/list/remove worktrees, changed_vs_base, dirty_paths), PathLeaseRegistry (acquire/release/owner_of), predict_overlaps pure pairwise check, IntegrationGate (prepare/merge_branch with conflict paths/run_check/advance). tests/workspace.rs: 6 tests on temp git repos (roundtrip, dirty paths, lease conflicts, overlap prediction, clean merge+advance, conflict reporting). 68 tests total, clippy/fmt clean.

Phase 5: src/router.rs — typed inboxes, scope/contract-aware routing, delivery tiers (Interrupt/Hook/NextTurn/NewTurn/Digested), anti-jam (rate limits, dedupe, digest batching, broadcast rules); src/context.rs — curated briefs, clean-context reviews, digest rendering; TaskGraph folds goals/decisions; Router wired into Coordinator publish/rebuild. tests/router.rs (9) + tests/context.rs (4). 82 tests total, clippy/fmt clean.

Phase 7: Artifact/Gate entities + ArtifactRecorded/GateOpened/GateDecided events folded in TaskGraph (dup/stale/double-decide rejected); src/verify.rs — open_gate/decide_gate/record_artifact/verify_artifact, reviewer loop cap 3, verification_status Verified/Unverified/Failed labeling; injection-marker quarantine (InstructionOverride/SystemDisclosure/RoleReassignment/PrivilegeEscalation) on router ingest. tests/verify.rs (6). 75 tests total, clippy/fmt clean.

Phase 8: src/eval.rs — ScenarioReport/ScenarioMetrics collected by replaying the log (message counts by kind, lease expiries, reclaims, discovery-to-action latency, zero human interventions), Baseline::{Solo,Mimae,NaiveChat}, compare_message_cost table. tests/eval.rs: 12 scenarios (conflict replan, midflight contract change, heartbeat death, crash recovery, solo-to-trio, reviewer cap, quarantine, blocker routing, milestone flood, integration conflict, convoy release, baseline cost comparison). 94 tests total, clippy/fmt clean.

Phase 9: src/daemon.rs — newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 dispatcher (17 methods) + threaded TCP serve loop on 127.0.0.1; src/bin/mimae-daemon.rs thin binary (--port/--log); Coordinator::events_since for poll subscription; PlanReceipt/GoalProgress now Serialize; README embedding section with protocol table; D20. tests/daemon.rs (7: dispatcher unit + live socket roundtrip). 101 tests total, clippy/fmt clean.

Head drive loop: src/drive.rs — drive_agent_turn (sweep, capability assign, adapter turn, advance to Done / mark Failed) and drive_goal (round-robin until complete or round cap) over &mut dyn AgentAdapter with caller clock. tests/drive.rs (4) with scripted adapter. 105 tests total, clippy/fmt clean.

Eval follow-up: 3 driven-goal scenarios in tests/eval.rs running drive_goal end-to-end with scripted adapters (two-agent completion, stall-then-reclaim with lease expiry + reclaim metrics, discovery message with measured seq latency). 114 tests total, clippy/fmt clean.

Framework embedding: src/host.rs — Mimae<H: HostHooks> facade (open/register_agent/create_team/mark_ready/submit_goal/drive/open_gate/record_artifact/propose_contract/record_decision/send_message/poll_approvals/drain_notifications/drain_events/claim_for_task) with NoHooks default; README + D21. tests/host.rs (2) full embed flow incl. approval hook and escalation delivery. 116 tests total, clippy/fmt clean.

Head loop: src/drive.rs — drive_head with HeadConfig (max_rounds, stuck_threshold, per-agent token budget), TurnReport.tokens_used from Usage events, early exit on consecutive idle rounds, stalled/over-budget/failed_tasks reporting; drive_goal untouched. tests/drive.rs (4 new). 120 tests total, clippy/fmt clean.
Review fix e426057: drain_notifications no longer destroys non-escalation inbox messages (new Router::drain_matching + regression test). 121 tests green, clippy/fmt clean.
